title: Zetwerk eyes ₹27,000 crore IPO valuation as over 30 investors weigh anchor book
summary: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA), Norway's central bank, and the asset management arms of Goldman Sachs, SBI and HDFC are among more than 30 foreign and domestic investors considering participation in Zetwerk's anchor book ahead of its IPO.

direction_reasons: FUNDRAISING cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
watch_next: confirmation from an official or company source
HDFCBANK.why_it_matters: The connection to the company is tenuous. The parts of the business most likely touched are balance sheet. Classified as fundraising.
